The BMW 7 Series has been updated! 

But this is no ordinary facelift. BMW claims it is the biggest facelift it has ever undertaken on any car EVER! In fact, the changes are so extensive, it’s effectively a totally new generation rather than a facelift. 

So does the new 7 Series have what it takes to stand out against its key competitors - the Audi A8 and Mercedes S-Class? Let’s take a look…

In terms of the exterior design, it’s still clearly a 7 Series, but with several differences from the previous iteration. Up top, there’s a completely new front end, with a bigger and more in-your-face grille, along with bigger air intakes. This car has the optional DRLs with 12 crystals included in them, and the grooves in the bonnet are the same as those first introduced in the recent M3.
